text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a certain day off, I was invited by 
Mejiro Ardan to the Mejiro family villa. 
She mentioned it was "a token of gratitude 
for the other day"—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Those words you shared back then, the 
"history of love"... My sister took quite 
a liking to them, and she has been in 
wonderful spirits ever since.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
While today is a Mejiro family gathering, 
the facilities here are quite extensive, 
so you should be able to relax and unwind, 
Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: Thank you! I appreciate the hospitality.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My sister has made today a rest day and is 
apparently already painting a new piece. 
Would you care to go see her?
choice_data_list: Thanks! I'll be in your care.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu held a paintbrush, staring 
intently at an unfinished painting against 
the wall. The atmosphere around her was 
cold, severe...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: S-Sister...? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—The snow... flutters behind my eyelids. 
Always, I did nothing but gaze from this 
window.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Are you speaking of the past?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I cannot help but mourn. The time that was 
out of reach...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If only I could have loved to my heart's 
content back then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Sis... ter...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Even though it is in the past, frustration 
continues to build... Though it seems 
unlike you, Sister...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I understand that feeling all too 
painfully. There are days when I, too, 
wonder what it would have been like had I 
been able to train from childhood.
choice_data_list: Still, seeing her like this is worrying...
Still, seeing her like this is worrying...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes... She is likely just letting her 
thoughts wander temporarily, but if her 
edges become too sharp...
choice_data_list: But that look is a little worrying...
But that look has me a little worried...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I see... that might very well clear her 
heart. Oh, since we have the Mejiro girls 
gathered here today—!
choice_data_list: How about going for a run to blow off steam?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—What is this? Bringing me out here all of 
a sudden...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Sister... please look at this vast turf. 
And—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
At the formidable runners gathered upon 
it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
At their unyielding spirit yearning for 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And at the burning passion of those who 
admire and chase after you. Won't you 
please accept their challenge?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for sorrow. Now, if you 
reach out your hand, you can touch it. 
Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: What you love, Sister, is right here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: That is... true. I can be beside it now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... and to think it was so obvious all 
along.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After confirming the distance and details 
of the course, Mejiro Ramonu stepped into 
the gate. The other girls followed suit, 
and the race began—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Ah............ Now, at any time, I can 
caress you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
These feelings... precisely because they 
grew beneath the snow...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
There was nothing to lament. So long as I 
have this love...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fu... fufu... Fufufu... haha...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... Fufufu... ah... ah...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah...! Sister, that was 
magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... how amusing...! It brings back 
memories of our very first tryst...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Tell me... my darling...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, she doesn't seem to hear me at all. 
Oh, Sister...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like a maiden whose heart throbs with 
first love. That was the pure and 
beautiful smile she showed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
How wondrous... with just this, the world 
sparkles.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Such a thumping pulse... such vibrant 
colors...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even afterwards, Mejiro Ramonu continued 
gazing lovingly at the turf until her 
heart was fully content.
